focus.label: Subcorneal pustular dermatosis (Sneddon-Wilkinson disease)
focus.why: The frontier 'Inflammatory dermatosis' (node-7) is too general. Biopsy evidence (node-8: subcorneal pustules with neutrophils and a few eosinophils) is the histologic hallmark of Sneddon-Wilkinson disease, and the well-demarcated annular plaques with central clearing (node-2) and refractoriness to terbinafine/miconazole (node-4) fit this non-fungal pustular entity. This is a finer-grained inflammatory pustular dermatosis consistent with all supporting evidence.

frontier.label: Subcorneal pustular dermatosis (Sneddon-Wilkinson disease)
